channel.title: HOLT ENGLISH
channel.description: Vocabulary Vault — 뉴스와 연구 이야기에 실제로 나온 영어 단어·표현·문장. 뜻, 원문, 함께 알아 두면 좋은 표현, 퀴즈까지.

item.title: turn myself in — 자수하다, 출두하다
item.description:
turn myself in — 자수하다, 출두하다

I'm going home. I will turn myself in.

I will turn myself in tomorrow.
내일 내 발로 출두할게.

사형 선고받은 방글라데시 전 총리, 돌아가겠다며 새 여권 신청

item.title: hold rates — 금리를 그대로 두다
item.description:

The US and Europe held rates. In Britain, some home loans now cost about £31 more a month.

item.description:

item.title: majority — 과반
item.description:

No party won a majority.

item.title: lonely — 외로운
item.description:

India is getting older fast. Of old people who live alone, 37 out of 100 say they feel lonely.

item.description:
